integrity: The exact algebraic proof handles every admissible parameter. The accompanying rational checker samples finitely many cases and is not an infinite proof. No field validation or independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: A homogeneous single finite store, equal-pulse deterministic periodic forcing, fixed fractional drainage and saturation-excess runoff; no stochastic storm or spatial catchment generalization. Historical priority relative to wider finite-buffer scheduling/majorization literature is provisional.
title: Exact cyclic-gap law for saturation-excess runoff from two periodic storms
